per_rule.rule: Every S_N in Acc_Info_dirty must exist as S_N in Cust_Bio_dirty (one-to-one join key integrity)
S_N must be unique across all records (no duplicate serial numbers)
Account_No must be exactly 4 digits (e.g., 1001, 1028)
Account_No must be unique (no duplicate account numbers)
Full_Name must be in Title Case (first letter of each word capitalized), except for lowercase particles (bin, binte, s/o, d/o)
Full_Name must not contain consecutive whitespace characters (double spaces)
ID must conform to Singapore NRIC/FIN format: one prefix letter (S, T, F, or G), followed by exactly 7 digits, ending with one uppercase checksum letter (9 characters total)
JoinDate must not be null
JoinDate must be a parseable datetime string (YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS or YYYY-MM-DD)
JoinDate must not be a future date (must be on or before today)
LastLogin must be a parseable datetime string (YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS)
JoinDate must be on or before LastLogin (account creation must precede or equal last login)
Subscription_Type must be one of: Basic, Free, Gold, Platinum, Premium
SubscriptionFee must not be null
SubscriptionFee must be parseable as a numeric value (float)
SubscriptionFee must not contain the sentinel/placeholder value '99999'
When Subscription_Type is 'Free', SubscriptionFee must be 0, '0', 'free', or null
Status must use the dominant boolean representations True or False
AccountBalance must not contain the sentinel/placeholder value 99999.0
AccountBalance must not be negative (must be >= 0)
PreferredLanguage must be one of: English, French, German, Malay, Tamil
Device must be one of: Desktop, Mobile, Tablet
OS must be one of the canonical values: Android, iOS, Linux, Windows, macOS
FeedbackScore must not contain the sentinel/placeholder value 7.3
FeedbackScore must be between 1.0 and 5.0 inclusive
FeedbackScore1 must be between 1.0 and 5.0 inclusive
ID must exactly match the ID_No value in Cust_Bio_dirty for the same S_N
Full_Name must match the Name value in Cust_Bio_dirty for the same S_N (allowing for case differences and minor variations)
